messages:
anna: Quick follow-up after the late-night p95 spikes. Root cause appears to be periodic cache thrash + a small routing imbalance. We need owners for remediation, SLO changes, and dashboarding. Proposed SLO adjustments: keep p50 at 45ms, tighten p95 from 320ms -> 200ms, set p99 to 900ms. Also want earlier error-budget alarm and a dashboard that surfaces fallback triggers. Please claim one item: 1) SLO config + migration notes, 2) dashboard + alert panels, 3) runbook + playbook for 02:00 UTC spikes, 4) routing fallback policy + metrics. Claim by EOD today.

mike: I9ll take item 1. Will draft the SLO change and include migration steps for Dedicated customers. Target PR: Mon EOD. Q: do we announce to customers first or open PR then announce?

anna: Open the PR first (internal review), then we send a short customer note before rolling to Dedicated. Keep change log in the PR.

sam: I9ll grab item 2. Plan: add an hourly p95 heatmap by region, a sparklines row for cache-miss-rate, and an alert: `error_budget_burn_rate > 1.2` sustained for 20m -> page eng-oncall. Will also add a fallback trigger panel.

sam: Dashboard query (promql):

avg_over_time(latency_p95[1h]) by (region)

sam: And a cache miss panel: `sum(cache_evictions_total) by (zone)`

priya: I9ll own item 3. Runbook additions: checklist to check cache eviction histogram, run `redis-cli INFO keyspace` quick commands, and rollback steps for routing. Will include exact commands and a small decision tree.

priya: Runbook snippet:

```
# check recent evictions
redis-cli --raw INFO stats | grep evicted
# quick fallback: set route to fallback-quant-policy
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://deploy.internal/route/fallback -d '{"policy":"fallback-quant"}'
```

oncall-bot: IncidentBot: postmortem created at 2191015200 -> https://infra/reports/2191015000

mike: Noted. I9ll include a migration note about SLO semantics and a rollback plan in the PR. Also will add a note about metric windows used to evaluate p95.

anna: Good. Sam/priya coordinate so fallback trigger in dashboard points to runbook step IDs. Also add an SLA note for customer-facing teams: if SLO change impacts contractual SLAs we escalate to sales-sd.

sam: Will link dashboard panels to runbook anchors. ETA for staging dashboards: Thu.

priya: Runbook + playbook draft by Wed. I9ll also add a short troubleshooting checklist for oncall.

mike: PR opened -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/slo-configs/pulls/112 (draft). Please review.

anna: Assigning action tracker items:
- mike: SLO PR + migration notes 4C5 due 2026-04-01
- sam: dashboards + alerts + fallback panel 4DD due 2026-03-30
- priya: runbook + spike playbook 4D6 due 2026-03-29
We9ll run a combined smoke test after changes and hold a short review in next oncall sync. Thanks all.

sam: Ping me if you want a walkthrough of the panels.

mike: Will follow up with the migration timeline and a small FAQ for customers.

oncall-bot: DeployTracker: staging dashboards deployed at 2191015320 (dash-staging-v7).
